hotel.name: explora en Rapa Nui, Posada de Mike

verified_facts.text: The lodge sits in a secluded spot on Easter Island, surrounded by trees, grasslands and far-reaching views over the Pacific Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: privileged and secluded location on Easter Island, surrounded by trees, grasslands and far-reaching views over the vast, blue Pacific Ocean

verified_facts.text: The lodge is a short distance from the main town of Hanga Roa and central to trailheads and archaeological sites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located just a short distance from the main town of Hanga Roa and central to trailheads and archeological sites

verified_facts.text: The lodge was designed by Chilean architect Jose Cruz Ovalle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explora Rapa Nui was designed by Chilean architect José Cruz Ovalle.

verified_facts.text: The lodge's interconnected volumes are reminiscent of the arrangement of the moai statues.
verified_facts.excerpt: Interconnected volumes, reminiscent of the arrangement of the moai statues, generate a sense of community and belonging

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have natural wood interiors, ocean or garden views and jetted bathtubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: each appointed with natural wood interiors, ocean or garden views, and jetted bathtubs

verified_facts.text: The Raa Suite takes its name from the Rapa Nui word for the sun.
verified_facts.excerpt: The suite name draws from the Rapa Nui word for the sun.

verified_facts.text: Varua, the name of the standard rooms, is a Polynesian word meaning spirit or soul.
verified_facts.excerpt: is a Polynesian word meaning spirit or soul

verified_facts.text: All rooms are equipped with air conditioning.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, all rooms are equipped with air conditioning.

verified_facts.text: The lodge has a full-service spa, Hare Vaka, offering massage and body treatments including options inspired by Polynesian and Rapa Nui wellness traditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explora Rapa Nui has a full-service spa — Hare Vaka — offering massage and body treatments, including options inspired by Polynesian and Rapa Nui wellness traditions.

verified_facts.text: An outdoor swimming pool and hot tub sit within the lodge grounds with views across the grasslands toward the Pacific Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explora Rapa Nui has an outdoor swimming pool and hot tub, situated within the lodge grounds with views across the island

verified_facts.text: The lodge has a sauna as part of its wellness facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explora Rapa Nui includes a sauna as part of the on-property wellness facilities.

verified_facts.text: Guided Explorations include hiking to the Rano Raraku moai quarry, biking to ancient ahu platforms, and kayaking and stand-up paddleboarding along the volcanic coastline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Options include hiking to the Rano Raraku moai quarry, biking to ancient ahu platforms, kayaking and stand-up paddleboarding along the volcanic coastline

verified_facts.text: Explorations include sunset bike rides to the massive moai ahu at Tongariki.
verified_facts.excerpt: sunset bike rides to the massive moai ahu at Tongariki

verified_facts.text: Explorations are limited to groups of no more than eight guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explorations are limited to a group size of no more than eight guests

verified_facts.text: Guides are trained at Explora's own School of Guides and are fluent in Spanish and English.
verified_facts.excerpt: trained at our own School of Guides and fluent in Spanish and English

verified_facts.text: Each evening an Explora guide meets with guests to tailor the next day's Explorations.
verified_facts.excerpt: something you’ll experience every evening, when your Explora guide meets with you to tailor the next day

verified_facts.text: The menu features local ingredients such as sweet potatoes, taro, fresh Pacific seafood and tropical fruits including Rapa Nui pineapple.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our menu features local ingredients like sweet potatoes, taro, fresh Pacific seafood and the island

verified_facts.text: The stay includes all guided Explorations, all meals and beverages, spa facility access, national park entrance fees and round-trip transfers from Mataveri International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: guided Explorations, all meals and beverages, spa facility access, national park entrance fees, and round-trip transfers from Mataveri International Airport (IPC)

verified_facts.text: The transfer from Mataveri Airport to the lodge is a short 15-minute journey by van.
verified_facts.excerpt: our team will pick you up in a van and transfer you to Explora, a short 15-minute journey

verified_facts.text: The flight from Santiago to Easter Island takes approximately 5 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: connect to a flight to Easter Island (Rapa Nui), which takes approximately 5 hours

verified_facts.text: Because of the remote location, Wi-Fi in rooms and common areas may vary in reliability.
verified_facts.excerpt: due to our remote locations, Wi-Fi access in rooms and common areas may vary in reliability

verified_facts.text: Explora recommends a minimum stay of four nights.
verified_facts.excerpt: We recommend a minimum of four nights

verified_facts.text: Individual spa treatments are booked separately and carry an additional charge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Individual spa treatments are bookable separately and carry an additional charge.

verified_facts.text: Scuba diving options come at an additional cost.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our exploration programs in Easter Island offer various scuba diving options for both beginners and experienced divers. These activities come at an additional cost

verified_facts.text: Easter Island lies some 2,300 miles (3,700 km) west of South America.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some 2,300 miles west of South America (3,700 km)
